entry.title: De La Fratta

buildingCutout.basis: Retain original6m standard Mapzen grid/native paths/water and every independent building. Only the three corresponding main castle/part shells are replaced with2cm pad. The court is level above sampled occupied-envelope maxima and nominally1.2m above the native approach endpoint; a narrowly bounded original faceted limestone outcrop extends down to sampled native grade around the castle, with buried contact skirts. It approximates the pictured cliff without changing terrain or claiming a surveyed rock face. Entrance treads follow the short mapped-side approach down to existing grade. No whole-ridge slab, terrain flattening or ground/water cutout. DEM greatly smooths the cliff: absolute court/foundation/rock levels and approach route are visualization fits.
